english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for opening or making something operative, including doors, eyes, valves, shops, accounts, and files.

exampleSentences.english: I open the file to take a look.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 hoi1 zo2 go3 man4 gin6 tai2

english.note: Use the all-purpose verb 開 for opening something, adding 少少 for opening it slightly and often naming the container for a packaged drink.

exampleSentences.english: I crack open the can of soda a little and drink it later.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我開少少罐汽水，等陣先飲。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 hoi1 siu2 siu2 gun3 hei3 seoi2 dang2 zan6 sin1 jam2
